title: Onboard titania-70b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR adds the titania-70b-v1.0 model to the registry with canonical metadata, validated performance profiles for common inference shapes, and a changelog/release-notes automation hook so future perf updates are tracked in the model's release notes. Motivation: titania-70b has strong on-device performance and we want a production-ready entry in the registry for customers evaluating 70B family models. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, quantization recommendations) - [x] Add canonical performance profile JSONs for tokens/seq-lengths used in our perf lab - [x] Add model card + sample prompts to examples directory - [x] Wire changelog automation that picks up changes to perf profiles and appends a release note draft to the model's changelog artifact - [x] Add smoke e2e job to CI that validates registry entry (light) - [x] Docs/README updated with migration notes Notes on scope: This PR intentionally does not include a quantized runtime artifact - that's scheduled in ENG-4998 where we will add vendor-specific quantization bundles. Performance profiles were generated by the perf-lab harness and validated against the canary pool; profiles include median/95th latency and token throughput for 8k/4k/1k contexts on A100 and H100-equivalent shapes. See commits and files_changed for details. If merged, the changelog automation will create a draft release note that the docs team can review before publish.

review_comments: Diego Morales (reviewer): Can you confirm the perf numbers include KV cache warmup? If not, we should annotate the profile to avoid confusion.
Asha Patel (author): Profiles are post-warmup (steady-state) with a 64-token prefix warmup; added note in perf_profiles metadata field.
Lina Zhang (reviewer): Small nit on tokenizer field in metadata.json — please include tokenizer model_version and BPE vocabulary hash for reproducibility.
Asha Patel (author): Added tokenizer.version and tokenizer.vocab_hash. Also included a short verification script in examples to reproduce tokenization checks.
Samir Kapoor (approver): Verified canary runs and CI smoke. Approving — good to squash-merge when CI is green.
release_notes: - Add: titania-70b-v1.0 model entry with canonical metadata and model card.\n- Add: validated performance profiles for A100/H100 across 1k/4k/8k contexts.\n- Add: changelog automation hook to draft model release notes when perf profiles or metadata change.
notes: QA/Perf: Perf lab run ids: perf-20251008-ttnA / perf-20251009-ttnH. Automation: changelog hook posts a draft file under models/titania-70b-v1.0/CHANGELOG.draft.md for docs review.
migration_instructions: None required for consumers; default model alias 'titania-70b' points to v1.0. If teams rely on older 70B variants, they can continue using pinned model ids.
